STANDARD TERMS OF CARRIAGE
1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 “Consignment” means any parcel or document
accepted by the Courier for delivery.
1.2 “Waybill” means the Courier's consignment note,
electronic or paper, issued for a Consignment.
3. ACCEPTANCE OF CONSIGNMENTS
3.1 The Customer shall ensure that each
Consignment is properly packed, addressed and
described on the Waybill. The Courier may refuse
any Consignment that is inadequately packed.
4. PROHIBITED GOODS
4.1 The Courier will not carry cash, firearms, danger-
ous goods, perishables or live animals. The
Customer indemnifies the Courier against any
loss arising from a prohibited Consignment.
5. CHARGES
5.1 Charges are calculated at the rates in Schedule A.
5.2 Invoices are payable within 30 days of statement.
5.3 Charges are based on the greater of actual
weight and volumetric weight (length × breadth
× height in cm ÷ 5 000).
6. LIABILITY
6.1 Unless the Customer has declared a value and
paid the insurance levy, the Courier's liability for
loss of or damage to a Consignment is limited to
R1 000.00 per Consignment.
7. CLAIMS
7.1 Claims must be submitted in writing within 7
(seven) days of delivery, or of the expected deliv-
ery date if the Consignment is not delivered.
8. DELIVERY TIMES
8.1 Delivery times are estimates. The Courier is not li-
able for delay unless caused by its gross
negligence.
9. TERMINATION
9.1 Either party may terminate this agreement imme-
diately on material breach by the other party.
10. LIEN
10.1 The Courier has a lien over all Consignments in
its possession for any amount owing by the
Customer.
11. PERSONAL INFORMATION
11.1 The Customer consents to the Courier processing
recipient names, addresses and telephone num-
bers for delivery and tracking.
12. GENERAL
12.1 These terms, the application and Schedule A are
the whole agreement. The Courier may amend
these terms on 30 days' written notice.
